title: Fix CLI OAuth callback deadlock
description: The Apricity login command blocks because its loopback callback reads to EOF before sending the browser response. Read only through HTTP headers, validate the callback, and reply immediately.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Root cause confirmed from the callback implementation: read_to_string waits for EOF, while browsers retain the request connection awaiting an HTTP response.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed and verified with the focused cloud test suite: the callback reads headers and responds before the browser closes its connection.
